title: GeoNode CSW metadata XML integrity
status: focused CSW serializer integrity checks pass; capability not accepted
changes: ISO 19115 metadata values are escaped as XML text before serialization, preventing caller-supplied values from breaking document structure or injecting elements; characters forbidden by XML 1.0 are replaced with U+FFFD.
CSW record responses declare the gmd and gco namespaces used by their child elements.
Focused tests parse both serializer outputs and verify markup-shaped input remains text.

verification.result: 15 passed, including 2 CSW serializer integrity tests
verification.ruff: python3 -m ruff check services/csw/serializer.py tests/test_csw_serializer.py: passed

scope_limits: This work does not add a CSW HTTP endpoint, catalog query implementation, or establish ISO 19115 semantic/output parity against a GeoNode reference fixture.
GIS/KML/raster ingestion parity, map and geostory runtime access, thesaurus integration, and MAN-CAP-063 owner acceptance remain open.
